summary: Duration::abs incorrectly saturated only the seconds field: Duration::new(i64::MIN, 0).abs() returned (i64::MAX, 0), whereas Duration::MAX has 999999999 nanoseconds. The fix uses checked_abs and returns Duration::MAX on seconds overflow. Both revisions already take the absolute value of nanoseconds; the candidate's negative-nanoseconds claim is inaccurate. The fix adds the detecting assertion to tests/duration.rs::abs, collected as duration::abs with all features enabled.
expected_failure:
assertion failed: `(left == right)`
  left: `Duration { seconds: 9223372036854775807, nanoseconds: 0 }`,
 right: `Duration { seconds: 9223372036854775807, nanoseconds: 999999999 }`
